# Synapse Automate

> Türkiye merkezli kurumsal AI otomasyonu, RevenueOS ve AI-native ürün platformu.

Canonical site: https://synapseautomate.github.io/
Contact: synapseautomate.ai@gmail.com | +90 552 202 98 50

## Current focus
- RevenueOS: inbound lead qualification, booking, follow-up, CRM and measurement.
- Active vertical: Roofing / Ev Hizmetleri.
- Founder Pilot: approved knowledge base, 30 FAQ, 8–12 intents, lead score, booking/human handoff, 3 follow-up messages, lead board and 30 test cases.
- Safety boundary: no autonomous critical pricing, payment, contract or sensitive advice; human approval is required.

## Core services
- AI Chatbot & Customer Service
- Sales & Lead Generation
- Accounting & Finance Operations
- HR & Recruitment
- Marketing, Content & SEO
- Legal & Compliance workflow support
- AI Training & Consulting
- RAG, custom AI and evaluations
- AI Audit & Optimization
- Process Mining
- Voice AI & Call Center
- Predictive Analytics

## Trust principles
Security > accuracy > evidence > usability > aesthetics.
No fabricated case studies, clients, metrics, guarantees or public links.
Unknown information remains unverified.
Cash collected means settled money only.
